asks.subject: FOIA request: plan review correction comments on 5 building permits
asks.summary: copies of the plan review correction comments the Department of Buildings issued to applicants on the 5 building permits listed below. All 5 are Standard Plan Review permits whose descriptions in the City's Building Permits dataset (ydr8-5enu) mention certified corrections.
records: Each Notification of Corrections Report, or equivalent notice of corrections, sent to the applicant, for every review cycle.

The text of the corrections and comments recorded for the application: the open and completed corrections in the Dynamic Portal (Hansen), and the review comments, checklist item comments and changemark comments in ProjectDox.
For each correction or comment, the review discipline, the date issued and the date resolved.
asks.format_note: A report or export from those systems, as PDF or CSV, is ideal. These comments are not in the Building Permits dataset, so a link to the data portal would not answer this request.
asks.exclude: architectural or engineering drawings, calculations, sealed documents, the applicant's resubmissions, Form 420, or certified correction sheets. If a comment exists only as a mark on a drawing, please provide its text and sheet number without the drawing. If that can't be done, please leave that comment out and tell me.
asks.narrowing: please contact me before denying any part of this request as burdensome. I would gladly start with the first review cycle on the first two permits.
asks.follow_on: If this works, ask for the other 10 permits in docs/chicago-foia-request.md as a separate batch.

pre_send: Open the Buildings FOIA page and confirm the address, email and online form. Then record it with confirm-contact.
Decide the commercial purpose paragraph with a lawyer. Declaring it means 21 working days, lower priority, possible search fees and almost no Public Access Counselor review.
Paste the whole request into the body of any email or form. The Act doesn't require a public body to open attachments or links.
Watch for a reply asking you to confirm you're a person. The clock stops, and it can deny after 30 days.
A search excerpt of the City's FOIA FAQ says requesters' names and request details are posted online. Assume a rival could see this.
lawyer: Is a reviewer's comment an 'other construction related technical document' under section 7(1)(k)? I found no ruling (see docs/chicago-real-data-plan.md).
Does testing a paid product count as a commercial purpose, and if we declare it, is any Public Access Counselor review left?
